commit_message: feat: add kanban cost ledger and budget enforcement

harness.home: $TEST_ROOT/home, HERMES_HOME=$TEST_ROOT/hermes-home, caches under $TEST_ROOT/cache (nothing under ~ or NFS)
harness.cleanup_proof: path absent after rm -rf; ls /var/tmp/hermes-governance-cost.* -> NO_LEFTOVERS

commands: scripts/run_tests.sh tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_cli.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_db.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_db_init.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_core_functionality.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_dispatch_claim_allowlist.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_dispatch_lock.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_dispatch_tick_hook.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_cli_dispatch_passthrough.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_default_assignee.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_review_lifecycle.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_review_lifecycle_complete.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_review_surfaces.py tests/hermes_cli/test_kanban_complete_live_claim_guard.py tests/tools/test_kanban_tools.py tests/tools/test_kanban_unknown_arguments.py tests/tools/test_kanban_toolset_opt_in.py tests/hermes_cli/test_config.py -q

acceptance_criteria_proven.migration_legacy_db: test_legacy_db_backfills_unknown_rows_idempotently: dropped stage-1 tables + reset _INITIALIZED_PATHS, reconnect recreates + backfills exactly one unknown row per historical run, NULL amounts, idempotent on second cycle, list_tasks still works
acceptance_criteria_proven.cost_attributed_to_exactly_one_run: test_worker_flush_attributes_cost_to_its_run_exactly_once: run_id PK, (run_id, task_id) fence rejects sibling, second flush cannot rewrite measured row (fill-only-from-unknown)
acceptance_criteria_proven.unknown_never_zero: test_worker_flush_without_usage_records_unknown_never_zero + session test_unpriced_rows_are_unknown_with_null_amounts_never_zero: cost_status='unknown' <=> amounts NULL; table-wide invariant query returns 0
acceptance_criteria_proven.warn_threshold: test_warn_threshold_lets_spawn_through_and_emits_one_deduped_event: spawn proceeds, exactly one budget_warn event, re-check does not refire
acceptance_criteria_proven.hard_stop: test_hard_stop_holds_spawn_two_ticks_one_event_and_reactivates_on_raise: no spawn over two consecutive ticks, exactly one budget_stopped event, card stays ready, raising the limit spawns on the next tick with no new event
acceptance_criteria_proven.month_window_utc: test_mtd_window_is_utc_month_only: previous-month ledger row not counted in current MTD; utc_period deterministic from run start
acceptance_criteria_proven.scope_priority: test_scope_priority_most_general_violation_names_the_stop + test_tenant_and_project_budgets_apply_to_matching_tasks_only: board before profile; tenant before project; scopes filter to matching tasks only (real projects.db rows)
acceptance_criteria_proven.flag_off_byte_identical: test_gate_off_leaves_dispatch_untouched: default off, spawn unchanged, zero budget events, budget_gate returns None before any query (probe connection raises on execute)
acceptance_criteria_proven.config_plumbing: test_budgets_config_reads_through_the_real_loader: DEFAULT_CONFIG keys kanban.budgets.{enabled,unknown_policy} read through the real loader; unknown_policy 'flag' stamps unknown_share into budget events
acceptance_criteria_proven.cli_surface: test_cli_budget_set_show_rm_roundtrip: hermes kanban budget set/show/rm incl. --monthly persist-key semantics, gated-tasks listing, fail-closed validation
acceptance_criteria_proven.worker_tool_read_only: test_kanban_budget_show_tool_is_registered_and_read_only: kanban_budget_show registered on the kanban toolset, read-only handler
acceptance_criteria_proven.review_mirror: test_review_mirror_skips_budget_stopped_rows: budget-stopped review rows do not withhold ready-lane capacity (_any_spawnable_review)

notes: Fixes over the inherited run-152 draft, found by first real execution: _LEDGER_COLUMNS was a 1-tuple (SQL syntax error near '('), argparse help string contained a bare % (broke every run_slash surface on Python 3.14 help validation), session_spend_totals rewritten against the real storage semantics (session_model_usage amount columns are NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; cost_status is the honest discriminator: actual/included/estimated/unknown).

SSH backend mux socket is degraded in this session; every write was verified via git diff / grep read-back instead of the tools' post-write hash verification (documented in the run-152 recovery comment).
